description: Unit tests for MIME type utility functions in the Chromium project, including MIME type parsing, extension mapping, boundary generation, and multipart form data handling.

methods.name: GetWellKnownMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type for a given file extension.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type(s) for a given file extension.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on file path.

methods.description: Checks if a MIME type matches a pattern.

methods.name: ParseMimeType
methods.description: Parses a MIME type string into type and parameters.
